entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hi, you're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I think... I think I need to return something? I bought these shoes a while ago, and I'm just so lost.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. The order number is... uh, hold on... VF-88612.

Thank you, Maria. I see the order right here for the VeloFit Spin Class shoes, delivered about two months ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

I don't really know. The website was a bit confusing. I wore the cycling shoes a couple of times and they gave me awful blisters. And the little metal things, the cleats? I couldn't figure them out at all. I just want a refund. Can't you just help me?

I'm very sorry to hear the shoes were uncomfortable and caused blisters, Maria. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just take a quick look at our return policy for you.
Okay... I hope it's not too late.
Alright, I've just reviewed your order date. It looks like you received the item 69 days ago. Our policy allows for returns on items like these for up to 90 days after delivery.
Oh, really? So I can still send them back? That's such a relief.

Yes, absolutely. Since you're well within that 90-day window, I can approve this return for a full refund for you right now. I am sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You can just pack the shoes up, attach the label, and drop them at the post office.
Wow, thank you so much, Charlie! That's so much easier than I thought it would be.
You're very welcome, Maria. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
